cases.name: Denise Huber
cases.about: She had graduated with a degree in social sciences from the University of California Irvine, and lived at home with her parents while working at The Old Spaghetti Factory.
cases.narrative: On 7/9/1994, her handcuffed, battered and nude body wrapped up in trash bags was discovered in a running, padlocked freezer in a stolen 24-foot yellow rental Ryder truck in his driveway. She was found on her knees, with her head bent down and her arms handcuffed behind her back. Cloth had been stuffed in her mouth, which was duct taped closed. Denise had been sexually assaulted and she’d died from blunt force trauma to the skull after being struck more than 30 times times in the head by what was likely a hammer.

cases.name: Leilani Dream Burley
cases.about: "My baby [Leilani] always lights up the room with her big beautiful eyes," her mother (Lynisha) Hull told KNBC-TV. "Leilani was only 1-year-old. She was full of life, and she was so beautiful and loved."
cases.narrative: On 12/5/2022, her body was found in the Los Angeles River below the Ocean Boulevard Bridge in Inglewood, CA. He allegedly threw her from a bridge.
